title: Clarify native relay recovery advice after confirmed home association loss
outcome: Confirmed home association loss explains the observed participant row and gives recovery steps suited to the requested operation.
acceptance: The local refusal accurately describes active participant evidence and the missing association without implying acknowledgement authority.
Remote advice distinguishes a page-read retry from receipt acknowledgement and describes the page read needed to recover a cold satellite route after replay.
The bounded relay reason and receipt and cursor protection remain in place.
